changes.text: TouchBridge: added. Tac-Retarget (arXiv 2610.40349) aligns PaXini fingertip contact from Manus-glove human demonstrations to two Wuji hands on a Moz1 robot; GR00T N1.7 fine-tuned only on converted data reaches 72.5% over 4 tasks against 77.5% with teleoperation; code marked coming soon.

Touch-JEPA: added. V-JEPA 2.1 model (arXiv 2610.28519) that estimates hand contact and tactile magnitude from video, trained with OpenTouch and HandSense touch; contact AUROC 0.862 on OpenTouch and 0.676 zero-shot on HRDexDB Allegro episodes; linked repository is empty.

ReDex: added. Force-conditioned behavior-cloning policy (arXiv 2610.07525) on a 12-DoF XHAND1 with five 120-taxel magnetic fingertip arrays, trained on human finger-level corrections; Object Flipping 14% to 86%; no code statement.

UpViTaL: added. ICRA 2025 tactile encoder learned from tactile-glove time series and fused with unpaired vision through an RL reward, so the robot hand needs no tactile sensors at deployment; closed access, only the abstract read.
